subject.title: feat: Control UI debug mode — ephemeral connection logs and error details

question: Which pre-auth Gateway connection details may the Control UI expose and copy for support, and should that surface live in the login gate, Debug page, or a shared diagnostic drawer?
rationale: The useful part of the request depends on product/security policy for browser-visible auth and connection metadata, not only on wiring a UI drawer.

options.title: Approve a redacted ephemeral log
options.body: Allow a session-only Control UI diagnostic drawer that records redacted lifecycle, close-code, and categorized handshake facts while excluding secrets, tokens, raw challenges, and private endpoints.

options.title: Keep diagnostics post-connect only
options.body: Limit browser diagnostics to existing connected Debug and logs surfaces, improving failure messages without exposing pre-auth frame details.

options.title: Route to support tooling
options.body: Do not add browser-side pre-auth diagnostics and instead invest in a separate doctor or support-bundle flow for connection failure reports.

recommendation.title: Approve a redacted ephemeral log
recommendation.body: Allow a session-only Control UI diagnostic drawer that records redacted lifecycle, close-code, and categorized handshake facts while excluding secrets, tokens, raw challenges, and private endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the clearest historical ownership signal for the Control UI Debug/dashboard behavior and product-facing failure UX.
